item: PubMed update-file fetch, consent-gated, gap shown (R750 a)
summary: One click reads NLM's update directory (guarded session held to ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/updatefiles/), checks each file's md5 under byte and inflate caps, keeps only cited or named records (R745), and shows how many cited identifiers are not found yet under a visible caveat (R750); files apply strictly in NLM order.
